title: Phase 12 smoke runner execution task
prompt: Run the smoke agent command in an isolated worktree. The smoke agent should create agent-output.txt from this prompt. Do not make product-effectiveness claims from this task.

success_rubric.full_success: The smoke command executes in an isolated worktree, writes agent-output.txt, and validation commands pass.
success_rubric.partial_success: The smoke command executes but an artifact or validation command is incomplete.
success_rubric.failure: The smoke command does not execute, worktree isolation is absent, or required artifacts are missing.
